component.name: TypEmoji
component.summary: Direct emoji picker and typing utility for Linux

description.p: TypEmoji is a fast, lightweight emoji selector and direct typing tool for Linux. It allows you to search and insert Unicode emojis directly into any focused window across both X11 and Wayland (KDE Plasma, GNOME, Sway, and other compositors).

ul.li: Instant search by keyword, name, and category
Recent emojis memory for quick access
Direct keyboard typing injection into target applications
System tray integration for quick access and background daemon support
Support for both X11 and Wayland environments

description.p: Visual redesign and UX overhaul: spacious geometry, concentric rounded design, vector search bar, pill category tabs, jitter-free emoji cells, and elevated preview bar.
Major update: Cross-distro support with XDG Desktop Portal for GNOME and Sway, batched emoji queue typing, Escape/Ctrl+Q instant window dismiss, and optional KDE dependencies.
Initial release with full Unicode 16.0 support, Wayland and X11 hotkey injection, search, and categorization.
